.modal {

    width: 100% !important;

display: none;

/* Hidden by default */

position: fixed;

/* Stay in place */

z-index: 1;

/* Sit on top */

padding-top: 200px;

/* Location of the box */

left: 0;

top: 0;

background-color: rgb(0, 0, 0);

/* Fallback color */

background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);

/* Black w/ opacity */

}

 

.modal-content{

position: relative;

background-color: #fefefe;

    width: 57%;

margin: auto;

padding: 0;

border: 1px solid #888;

box-shadow: 0 4px 8px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2), 0 6px 20px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.19);

-webkit-animation-name: animatetop;

-webkit-animation-duration: 0.4s;

animation-name: animatetop;

animation-duration: 0.4s

}

 .secondModal-content{

position: relative;

background-color: #fefefe;

    width: 57%;

margin: auto;

padding-left: 0px;

border: 1px solid #888;

box-shadow: 0 4px 8px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2), 0 6px 20px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.19);

-webkit-animation-name: animatetop;

-webkit-animation-duration: 0.4s;

animation-name: animatetop;

animation-duration: 0.4s

}

 

@media (max-width : 767px){

guidetextdraw_1261159726._value:
1) Serious and compelling circumstances:

Based on University withdrawal policy, a “serious and compelling reason” is defined as “ . . . a physical, medical, emotional or other condition which has the effect of limiting the student’s full participation in the class and which is clearly beyond the student’s control.”

The serious and compelling circumstances that occurred in the semester I am petitioning for retroactive withdrawal were:
guidetextdraw_1261159726.name: textdraw_12611597261669976387928

guidetextdraw_544450044._value: If your statement continues on a separate sheet of paper, your signature must be included at the end of the statement.
guidetextdraw_544450044.name: textdraw_5444500441669976666152

guidetextdraw_1503180794._value: 2) Documentation: Documentation must be from an independent source. Depending on your circumstances, some examples of independent documentation could be employer verification, medical documents, legal paperwork, etc. Letters from family members or friends are not acceptable documentation for retroactive withdrawal petitions.
guidetextdraw_1503180794.name: textdraw_15031807941669977133769

guidetextdraw_1350188680._value: IMPORTANT: If medical circumstances are indicated in the student’s petition statement, they are to be those of the student’s own personal circumstances, and accompanied by medical or other types of caregiving information. If the medical circumstances were related to a family member, documentation from an independent source must be provided for the difficulties, hardships and/or increased responsibilities that the student experienced in the situation described.
guidetextdraw_1350188680.name: textdraw_13501886801669977212899

guidetextdraw_1716263908._value: ALL STUDENTS: Documentation is required. If documentation is insufficient, the petition may be denied. Student may resubmit new petition when documentation is obtained.
guidetextdraw_1716263908.name: textdraw_17162639081669977313038

guidetextdraw_873163872._value: 3) I did not withdraw from this class by following standard withdrawal procedures at the time because:
guidetextdraw_873163872.name: textdraw_8731638721669977597151

guidetextdraw_165152999._value: 4) In the semester I am petitioning for retroactive withdrawal, I received letter grades for other classes.

guidetextdraw_1862352869._value: If ‘Yes’, why were you able to complete the requirements for other classes, but not the class(es) you are petitioning for retroactive withdrawal?
guidetextdraw_1862352869.name: textdraw_18623528691669981764096

guidetextdraw_165152._value: 5) In the class I am petitioning for retroactive withdrawal, my record currently shows an ‘I’ (Incomplete).
guidetextdraw_165152.name: textdraw_1651529991669981654454_copy_1

guidetextdraw_1001985968._value:
Medical documentation required to support student's petition:

  1. Official letterhead including name and title of attending healthcare provider with phone number and address of medical or mental health facility.
  2. Date of the onsent of student's systems prohibiting them to perform academically.
  3. General description of the student's medical condition.
  4. Reason why and how the medical condition prevents them from completing their coursework.
  5. Statement indicating if the provider recommends withdrawal from all or some of their classes.
guidetextdraw_1001985968.name: textdraw_10019859681747998022788

guidetextdraw_1318996119._value: Note: Medical charts, notes, lab results, x-rays, hospital records, discharge papers, police reports, and medically related pictures or images are NOT sufficient medical documentation for a medical retroactive withdrawal petition.
